source: Suppose a kernel repeatedly cycles through 8 MiB of data and the relevant shared cache has ample effective space for that region. Reuse may be captured well. If the same kernel cycles through hundreds of megabytes while many other clients compete for the cache, a larger fraction of requests will need to go farther out.
zh: 假设内核重复循环 8 MiB 数据，并且相关共享缓存有足够的有效空间用于该区域。重用可能会被很好地捕获。如果同一个内核循环数百兆字节，而许多其他客户端竞争缓存，则较大部分的请求将需要发送到更远的地方。
